title: Punnets
html_source:
Small baskets used to hold produce such as berries; etym. thought to be diminutive of “pun”, from “pound”.

Though you may assume, as I did, that the genetic diagramming technique known as a Punnett square derives its name from these baskets, it is in fact the eponymous device of geneticist Reginald Crundall Punnett
